## Procedure

1. From the start position, press the bar straight overhead by extending the arms and keeping the body stable (-22)
2. At the top of the lift, the bar should be slightly behind the ears with elbows completely extended and in line with the shoulders, hips, and heels
3. Lower the bar to its starting position across the shoulders in a controlled manner
